title: Listen, Beloved
program_note: The three poems set here are taken from e. e. cummings’ small collection O R I E N T A L E; all three could be said to be “about” ways of interacting with one’s love:  jealous possessiveness (listen beloved ...), worship (unto thee ...), or sensitive but fruitless attempts at communication (i spoke to thee ...).  The duration of the entire set is just under 14 minutes:  2:45, 7:15, and 3:45.
